tools.name: get_email
tools.description: Verify the email instantly Billing per call: 1 Credits.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "verify-the-email-instantly" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_email · Public sink: get_email.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_email · Public sink: get_email

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
